title: Update: How COVID-19 Is Affecting Facebook Marketplace Leads for Commercial Truck and Trailer Dealers
description: After tracking Facebook Marketplace message trends through the summer, the data shows COVID-19 caused no dip in lead generation for commercial truck and trailer dealers — leads trended above average.

props.text: July and August numbers confirm the pandemic is a non-factor for Marketplace lead generation.

In a previous article, we reported Facebook Marketplace messages seeing an uptick through May and June. We are happy to report now, after seeing July and August numbers, the COVID-19 pandemic seems to be causing no issue to this platform for lead generation.

items.label: OEM dealers (Dealer 1, Dealer 2): looking at these trends more closely, these dealers were getting more leads than ever in May and June.
Used truck dealers (Dealer 3, Dealer 4): the hardship has not affected the amount of leads coming in since February.
July returned a little bit of a downturn for our Heavy Truck dealers as compared to June, implying a return to average leads, but overall has been trending above average.
August is showing a continued upturn for our dealers across the board.

props.text: August has shown even further evidence the pandemic is a non-factor for Facebook Marketplace. We will, again, keep monitoring this trend in upcoming months and keep you informed.
